head: 85ad366a27c48e88d16381cc542e8074b5d5d461
classification_reasons: Spec is not tight by the article's test: one flagged concern is left open on purpose (intent Constraints say tests/test_calc.py is not changed, intent Proposed outcome changes the message tests/test_calc.py::test_percent_zero_whole_error_names_whole asserts; the design picks the Proposed outcome and leaves the choice to the owner or the panel).

Blast radius is small: one string literal in sample_pkg/calc.py, one added test in tests/test_messages.py, one assertion updated in tests/test_calc.py; no risk-list item, no schema, no contract, no guardrail file.
Existing tests already cover the changed path (test_percent_zero_whole_raises, test_percent_zero_whole_error_names_whole, test_percent); the acceptance targets are measurable exact-string assertions.
attempted: Intent: the spec's first requirement is the intent's Proposed outcome verbatim (percent(5, 0) -> "cannot express 5 as a percent of zero"); exception type, return value on a non-zero whole, divide/add/mean unchanged, new test in tests/test_messages.py, green targets: all carried. Both intent open questions are answered with the intent's own defaults and a code-based justification (str() rendering as divide does at calc.py:10; own message because divide would say "cannot divide 500 by zero" for percent(5, 0)). Nothing nearby was solved instead of the stated problem.

Spec and plan: every Proposed outcome and Constraint maps to a requirement; the one contradiction inside the intent (test_calc.py untouched vs. message changed) is stated honestly as the single flagged concern, with the choice, the reason, the alternative and who decides. plan.md lists three files with exact lines and exact strings, in an order that matches the spec's design; an engineer with plan.md alone can implement it. Diff at HEAD touches only changes/0017-*/ (intent, spec, plan, status, evidence), nothing outside the change folder, no guardrail file.

Proof: phase (b) is read-only, so no toolchain logs are expected and none are claimed; the plan's Proof section names the new test (tests/test_messages.py::test_percent_zero_whole_names_part), the updated assertion, every existing test by name and the expected count (12 passed = today's 11 + 1). I counted today's suite: 9 in test_calc.py, 1 in test_messages.py, 1 in test_flag.py = 11; the count is right (the earlier design commit said 11 and was corrected at HEAD).

Blast radius: Grep for "whole must not be zero" over the repository finds it outside change folders only in sample_pkg/calc.py:18 and tests/test_calc.py:28, exactly as plan.md Risks claims; sample_pkg/__init__.py re-exports the four names and does not move; CLAUDE.md Layout's sentence on percent ("raises the same on a zero whole") already describes the type, not the text, since percent already raises its own message today, so CLAUDE.md is not made outdated; no risk-list item (auth, data migrations, money movement, production config), no guardrail file in the diff.

Policies: coding-standards rule 4 is met (a new exact-message test that fails on today's code); the test_calc.py assertion update is a feature-type change updating a pinned old message, not a weakened or deleted failing test, and the design says so rather than hiding it; security-baseline, data-conventions and ux-conventions non-applicability is argued per rule and matches the code (library, numeric args, no storage, no logs); the message echoes a value the caller passed, no new exposure.

Tests: the new test asserts the exact string for percent(5, 0), so formatting part*100, whole or dropping the part would fail it; the updated test_calc.py assertion covers percent(1, 0); from None being dropped by accident is not caught by any test, and the plan records this as a risk with an option not taken (asserting __cause__ is None) rather than silently; the retained test name test_percent_zero_whole_error_names_whole no longer describes what it asserts, a nit the plan acknowledges, not a reason.
Skip markers: not applicable at phase (b); no test is skipped, narrowed or deleted in the design.

Claims against today's code, each read in the working tree (today's code at (b)): calc.py:10 is f"cannot divide {a} by zero" (true); calc.py:16 is return divide(part * 100, whole) (true); calc.py:18 is raise ZeroDivisionError("whole must not be zero") from None (true); test_calc.py:25-28 is test_percent_zero_whole_error_names_whole calling percent(1, 0) and asserting the old message on line 28 (true); test_messages.py imports only divide and holds one test test_divide_by_zero_names_dividend (true); test_percent asserts percent(1, 4) == 25.0 and percent(7, 100) == 7.0 (true); mean rejects an empty collection before dividing by len(values) and raises ValueError("mean() requires at least one value") (true); status.yaml change_type: feature, tests_locked: false (true); sdlc.yaml test_paths covers tests/** and the lock is fix-only (true: framework/plugin/hooks/test_file_lock.py line 122 requires change_type == "fix" and tests_locked); plan_sync requires plan.md in the commit only for source files not listed under "Files that change" (true: framework/plugin/hooks/plan_sync.py lines 143-168); change 0016's spec settled str()/f-string rendering for divide in its Open questions (true); CLAUDE.md names tests/test_messages.py as the module that checks the error messages (true). docs/decisions/index.md does not exist in this project and the spec cites no decision file. No claim contradicted the code.

Deferred review: the panel's files and the concern's closing are not expected in this diff and their absence is not a reason; the open concern is the gate's and the panel's or owner's item (evidence/panel/b-items.json lists it as pending), not a design defect. The runner's records (run-b.json, adversarial-review-b.model.json from the earlier round at 310c22a) were not used for or against the change.
